name_en: Saba somen — somen noodles simmered in grilled mackerel broth
summary_ja: 焼きサバを甘辛く煮込み、その煮汁でそうめんを味付ける湖北地域の料理。若狭から鯖街道を経て届いたサバを、田植え時期に嫁ぎ先へ贈る「五月見舞い」の風習とも結びついて伝わってきたという。
summary_en: Grilled mackerel is simmered in a sweet-savory sauce, which is then used to season somen noodles. The dish traces back to mackerel carried along the old "Saba Kaido" route from Wakasa, and to a custom of sending preserved mackerel to newly married daughters during the busy rice-planting season.
source_title: 鯖そうめん 滋賀県
